final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Partial unreachability traced from the entry caller to node worker-02's container runtime. Frontend (entry service) error logs contain 221 errors dominated by 'could not retrieve product/currencies/complete the order: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = no healthy upstream' (107/80/32 counts). Pods inventory splits perfectly along the node boundary: all 5 healthy 2/2 Running pods are on worker-01, while all 6 pods stuck in Init:0/1 with IP <none> (productcatalogservice, currencyservice, paymentservice, checkoutservice, recommendationservice, shippingservice) are on worker-02. Endpoints for productcatalogservice are '<none>', the direct source of 'no healthy upstream'. Mechanism event on the pod sheet and confirmed across the namespace events surface: 'Warning FailedCreatePodSandBox ... Failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = ... dial unix /run/containerd/containerd.sock: connect: no such file or directory' for currencyservice-5cd6467fc4-w9zcv, paymentservice-869f9f96cd-kngfk, checkoutservice-dbcdcb5fb-hgk6l and productcatalogservice-6fb89f98f8-vxfzt; worker-02 pods show only 'Normal Scheduled' with no 'Started container', while worker-01 pods show 'Started container server'. Component confirmation: containerd.service on worker-02 is 'Active: inactive (dead) since Fri 2026-01-02 13:09:46 CST' / 'Stopped containerd container runtime' (just before the pods were created at 13:10:06), whereas kubelet.service is 'active (running)' yet logs 'Skipping pod synchronization err="container runtime is down"' and 'GenericPLEG: Unable to retrieve pods'. GetClusterConfiguration shows worker-02 status NotReady with node.kubernetes.io/not-ready taints. Root cause: containerd unavailable on node worker-02, leaving its pods without a pod sandbox and therefore no ready endpoints.
